name: Digital Strategy and Business Model
description:
This course contains the following topics:
Introduction to digital transformation
New technologies like Artificial Intelligence (AI) and how they could be applied in a business.
Business opportunities and platforms in a digital economy
The platform revolution.
Harnessing the crowd: how the crowd (decentralised knowledge) outperforms the core (centralised knowledge).
Impact of digital technologies on organisational structure and the changing roles of managers and leaders.
